abstract: A twenty-four-year-old male patient with stage III advanced extragonadal germ-cell tumor obtained complete remission after comprehensive treatment including high-dose combination chemotherapy with autologous bone marrow transplantation. He had massive tumors in cervical, mediastinal, abdominal and inguinal lymph nodes, bilateral lungs and liver. Ascites, plural effusion and pericardial effusion were also noted. Cancer cells were demonstrated from his bloody sputum, pericardial drainage and an aspirate from supraclavicular tumor. His tumor produced hCG, AFP, placental ALP and LDH, and hCG was the best marker for the diagnosis and monitoring. The initial serum hCG level was high at 460,000 mIU/ml, but fell to 13 mIU/ml after 3 courses of PVP therapy. However, it rose ten-fold in a week. After ultra-high dose combination chemotherapy with autologous BMT, the patient's hCG fell to 1.8 mIU/ml and remained at that level thereafter. He has remained well with no sign of recurrence after 25 months.
abstract_ja: 病期IIIの性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を有する24歳男性が、高用量併用化学療法と自家骨髄移植を含む集学的治療により完全寛解を得た。頸部、縦隔、腹部、鼠径部のリンパ節、両肺、肝臓に巨大な腫瘍が多発していた。腹水、胸水、心嚢水も認めた。血痰、心嚢ドレナージ液、鎖骨上腫瘍の穿刺吸引液から癌細胞が検出された。腫瘍はヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、胎盤型ALP、LDHを産生し、診断とモニタリングにはhCGが最も優れた腫瘍マーカーであった。初診時の血清hCGは460,000 mIU/mlと高値であったが、PVP療法3コース後に13 mIU/mlまで低下した。しかし1週間で10倍に上昇した。超高用量併用化学療法と自家骨髄移植の後、hCGは1.8 mIU/mlまで低下し、その後もその水準を維持した。25か月経過した時点で再発の兆候はなく、良好に経過している。
